THE TARIFF ACT (SECOND AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1959
THE TARIFF ACT
(SECOND AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1959
ORDINANCE No. LII OF 1959
[18th September, 1959]
An Ordinance further to amend the Tariff Act, 1934
1. Short title and
commencement.---(1) This Ordinance may be called the Tariff Act (Second
Amdt.) Ordinance, 1959.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

[Amendment of the First Schedule, Act XXXII of 1934]

Certain duties not be levied or collected on certain goods

THE TARIFF ACT

3. Certain duties not be
levied or collected on certain goods.----The additional duties of customs
referred to in section 8 of the Finance (No. 2) Ordinance, 1959, shall not be
levied or collected in respect of any of the items specified in the table to
section 2 of this Ordinance, XXXIV of 1959.
